function.arguments: {"finding": "The `channel` variable is not randomly assigned — the email campaign was deliberately targeted at returning and loyal customers, who are higher-value segments. This creates a confounding: the email channel appears to generate more revenue not because of the channel itself, but because of the higher-value customer segments it targets. A direct comparison of total revenue between channels is therefore confounded.", "implication": "The raw revenue comparison between channels is invalid. function.name: note_finding
